name: Potion of Animal Friendship
summary: A potion that lets you cast Animal Friendship.

stats.effect:
When you drink this potion, you can cast the level 3 version of the *{ref:spell/animal-friendship}* spell (save DC 13).

Agitating this potion's muddy liquid brings little bits into view: a fish scale, a hummingbird feather, a cat claw, or a squirrel hair.
